policy: After 09:15 on every live GPW session, the primary pipeline must end with one best valid stock unless hard data-quality or execution-price conditions make a safe selection impossible. Historical feature data may lag by at most one completed session; current-session execution price must remain fresh. The final selector reranks up to eight highest quantitative candidates with a bounded 25% Opening Confirmation overlay using gap quality, return from the open, intraday range position and distance from the session high.
